_description: Codex quota gate read by codex-delegate.mjs before every non-dry-run delegation. Each role's number is both its threshold and the quota it reserves while it runs. A run is allowed only if (100 - used% of the window) - sum(reservations of ongoing runs) - this role's number > 0. Ongoing = runs recorded as running or submitted_background that started within the last window. Shared across machines: edit, commit, push, pull, deploy. Author: maintained with Claude Code for the frontier-model orchestration setup.
